HomeHero.morningTitle: Mwaramutse! Ibihe bya Bibiliya by’uyu munsi biragutegereje.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Tangira umunsi wawe n’ibihe bya Bibiliya bitera ubutwari, bigamije kugukomeza no kuzamura umutima wawe.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Mwiriwe! Ibihe bya Bibiliya by’umunsi wawe.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Ibikubiye muri Bibiliya bitera ubutwari, bikwiriye ikiruhuko cyawe cyo ku manywa cyangwa gukomeza kugira inkomezi.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Mwiriwe! Soza umunsi n’ibihe bya Bibiliya.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Ibihe bya Bibiliya bituje bigufasha gutekereza no kubona ihumure igihe umunsi wawe urangira.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Isarura rirageze. Twifatanye mu kugeza Ubutumwa Bwiza ku isi yose dukoresheje itangazamakuru rya digitale.
HomeHero.togetherTitle: Tuvuge inkuru ya Yesu, twese hamwe
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Kugira ngo bumve kandi babone urukundo rwa Yesu mu rurimi rwabo, aho bari hose.

Mission.headline: Ubutumwa ntibuhinduka. Uburyo abantu bareba ni bwo buhinduka.
Mission.intro: Turimo kongera kubaka isomero ryacu rya videwo n’ibikoresho byacu duhereye ku musingi, tujyana imyaka myinshi y’umurimo w’ubuhinduzi ku mbuga abantu basanzwe bahuriraho, bareberaho kandi basangiriraho.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Isomero rya filime ryahinduwe mu ndimi nyinshi kurusha andi ku isi
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Imyaka myinshi y’umurimo w’ubuhinduzi, wakozwe n’abafatanyabikorwa bizewe mu murimo w’Imana, yubatse isomero rifite amajwi mu ndimi ibihumbi, kugira ngo abantu bahure n’inkuru ya Yesu mu rurimi rubakora ku mutima kurusha izindi.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Kugeza amajwi yizewe mu buryo bushya
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Turimo kuvugurura uburyo inkuru z’Ubutumwa Bwiza zivugwa mu mashusho, duhuza ubuhinduzi bwizewe n’uburyo bugezweho kugira ngo ubutumwa bugere hose: ku mbuga, mu mico itandukanye no kuri ecran zose.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Birenze isomero. Ni itsinda rifite intego y’ivugabutumwa.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project ni itsinda mpuzamahanga ry’abahinduzi, inzobere mu itangazamakuru, abatunganya n’abahanzi, bahindura imyaka myinshi y’uburambe mu murimo ibikoresho bifasha abahindura abantu abigishwa aho bari hose.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Guhuza abareba n’amahirwe afatika mu rugendo rwabo rwo mu mwuka, tubafasha gutera intambwe ikurikira igana mu muryango w’abizera, mu Byanditswe cyangwa mu murimo w’ivugabutumwa.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Isomero rinini ry’itangazamakuru rya gikristo, rifite videwo, filime n’ibindi bikoresho ibihumbi biboneka mu ndimi nyinshi, bigenewe umurimo w’Imana n’ivugabutumwa ku isi hose.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Gucunga videwo, gukwirakwiza ibirimo, kwegera abayireba n’isesengura, byagenewe gufasha imirimo y’Imana kugera ku bantu benshi mu buryo bunoze.
Mission.inviteBody: Turatumira abakora umurimo, abahanzi n’abafatanyabikorwa kugerageza mbere y’abandi. Gerageza ibikoresho bishya mbere, utange ibitekerezo, kandi udufashe kunoza ibikoresho byagenewe umurimo nyawo w’ivugabutumwa.
